commitResults.messageTitle: Assign a CandidateId when candidates are added
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a permanent CandidateId to Person so that candidates can later be
referred to by ID instead of by list position.

- Add the CandidateId value class (positive integer).
- Add an optional candidateId to Person. It is empty until the model
  assigns one, and is not part of Person#equals or hashCode.
- HireBase gives each new candidate the next ID and keeps a counter that
  only increases, so the ID of a deleted candidate is never reused.
- Add unit tests for CandidateId, Person and HireBase.

Save each candidate's CandidateId and the next-ID counter to the data
file, and show the ID on the candidate card.

- JsonAdaptedPerson reads and writes candidateId, rejecting
  non-positive values.
- JsonSerializableHireBase reads and writes nextCandidateId, so the ID
  of a deleted candidate is still not reused after a restart.
- Data files without IDs (older files) still load; candidates are
  numbered in file order after any stored IDs.
- Files with duplicate candidate IDs or an invalid counter are rejected
  with a clear message.
- PersonCard shows "ID: n" under the name. The list position is kept
  for now because commands still use it.
- Add storage tests for IDs, old files, round trips and invalid data.

Command syntax is unchanged.

Part of #121

commitResults.messageTitle: Store events and assign event IDs in HireBase
commitResults.messageBody:
Events had no home in HireBase and no code ever assigned an EventId,
so no event command could work.

Add an event list with a monotonic nextEventId counter, mirroring
job IDs. An event without an ID gets the next one; an event with an
ID keeps it and moves the counter past it. The counter only moves
after a successful add, and resetData and the copy constructor carry
it across, so a deleted event's ID is never reused.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expose events and conflict detection in Model
commitResults.messageBody:
Event commands need to add, edit, delete and look up events by ID,
and add event must warn about clashes without blocking them.

Add addEvent, which returns the stored event so callers can show
its ID, plus setEvent, deleteEvent, getEventList and findEvent. Add
getConflictingEvents as a default method: it returns overlapping
events in list order, ignoring cancelled events and the event
itself. Back-to-back events do not conflict.

commitResults.messageTitle: Guard event conflicts and candidate deletion
commitResults.messageBody:
Lock in two behaviours that later event features rely on.

An edited event keeps its ID, so the conflict check must not report a
clash with its own old time. Deleting a candidate keeps their ID in
events, so view event can show them as deleted instead of silently
losing who attended.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save events and the event ID counter to disk
commitResults.messageBody:
Events were lost on restart because storage ignored them.

Add JsonAdaptedEvent, which stores dates as ISO yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm so
saved files do not depend on the display format. Parse strictly and
reject wrong JSON types, invalid dates, bad time ranges and invalid
IDs. Save events and nextEventId in JsonSerializableHireBase. Files
without events still load, and any invalid event rejects the whole
file instead of being silently dropped. Candidate IDs with no matching
candidate are kept.

Closes #192

Very long names can break the calendar layout, and EventName only
rejected blank names.

Check the length in EventName so that commands and saved data both
enforce it. Count characters after trimming, as code points, so an
emoji counts as one character. Tests cover each length partition and
both sides of the limit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add add event command with conflict warning
commitResults.messageBody:
Recruiters need to put interviews and meetings on their calendar
and see when they clash, so they can deconflict them.

Parse add event n/NAME from/DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM to/DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM
[desc/DESCRIPTION] [c/CANDIDATE_ID]... with strict dates, so values
such as 31/04 or 24:00 are rejected instead of silently adjusted.
Reject d/, which add job uses for the department, instead of letting
it be absorbed into another field. Reject unknown candidate IDs and
exhausted event IDs before anything changes. Overlapping events are
listed with their IDs as a warning, but the event is still added.
Store events in HireBase and expose them in Model

commitResults.messageTitle: Save new events before showing them
commitResults.messageBody:
If saving a new event failed, it still appeared in the app but was
missing from the data file, and its event ID was used up.

Add the event to a copy of the model and save that copy first. Only
after the save succeeds is the exact saved event added to the real
model, so the app and the file always agree on its ID. A failed save
changes nothing, and the next event gets the unused ID.
